definitions.connectivity: Undirected simple projection: reciprocal arcs collapse; loops excluded; all roster nodes retained.
definitions.betweenness: Exact shortest-path betweenness; endpoints excluded; normalized by all pairs of other roster nodes. Unreachable pairs contribute zero.
definitions.ranking: Original undirected degree or original betweenness descending, ties by node ID. Ranks are static, never recomputed after removal.
definitions.random: Uniform random permutations of the full roster, one continuous trajectory per trial; 200 trials with Python random seed 2026. Shaded band is pointwise empirical 5th–95th percentiles, not a confidence interval.
definitions.denominator: Largest remaining component divided by original complete roster size, including original isolates, at every step.
definitions.routes: A shortest route from the selected page to Spider-Man. Directed mode follows article hyperlinks; undirected mode permits either orientation. Sorted node IDs break ties. No route is not an infinite displayed distance.
